title: Cookbook
text: examples use clindata sample data. Install GitHub (Gilead-BioStats/clindata) explore input datasets (rawplus_dm, rawplus_ae, rawplus_visdt) understand expected column structure.
code: dfSubjects <- clindata::rawplus_dm  dfNumerator <- clindata::rawplus_ae  dfDenominator <- clindata::rawplus_visdt %>%   dplyr::mutate(visit_dt = as.Date(visit_dt, "%Y-%m-%d"))

title: Cookbook
text: full analysis chain raw data visualization:
code: gsm.timez::Timeline(   dfSubjects            = dfSubjects,   dfNumerator           = dfNumerator,   dfDenominator         = dfDenominator,   strGroupCol           = "invid",   strSubjectCol         = "subjid",   strNumeratorDateCol   = "aest_dt",   strDenominatorDateCol = "visit_dt" ) %>%   gsm.timez::Analyze_TimeZFunnel() %>%   gsm.timez::Flag(vThreshold = c(-1.5, -1, 2, 3)) %>%   gsm.timez::Visualize_Heatmap(nSites = 10) #> ℹ Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 2.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: -2.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 1.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: -1.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 0.

title: Cookbook
text: Timeline() generates site-level timeline cumulative numerator events sequential months, producing one row per site-month combination:
code: dfTimeline <- gsm.timez::Timeline(   dfSubjects            = dfSubjects,   dfNumerator           = dfNumerator,   dfDenominator         = dfDenominator,   strGroupCol           = "invid",   strSubjectCol         = "subjid",   strNumeratorDateCol   = "aest_dt",   strDenominatorDateCol = "visit_dt" )  knitr::kable(head(dfTimeline))

title: Cookbook
text: Analyze_TimeZFunnel() applies gsm.core::Analyze_NormalApprox() monthly cross-section calculate funnel plot score site:

title: Cookbook
text: Flag() adds Flag column identifying statistical outliers based z-score thresholds:
code: dfFlagged <- gsm.timez::Flag(dfTimeZScore, vThreshold = c(-1.5, -1, 2, 3)) #> ℹ Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 2.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: -2.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 1.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: -1.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 0.

title: GSM YAML Workflow: HTML Report
code: lSource <- list(   Source_STUDY = clindata::ctms_study,   Source_SITE = clindata::ctms_site,   Source_SUBJ = clindata::rawplus_dm,   Source_AE = clindata::rawplus_ae %>% dplyr::select(-aetoxgr),   # gsm.mapping expects a studyid column, but clindata::edc_data_pages uses   # protocolname instead. DATAENT itself is not used by gsm.timez but is   # required by gsm.mapping's AE workflow.   Source_DATAENT = clindata::edc_data_pages %>%     dplyr::mutate(studyid = protocolname),   Source_VISIT = clindata::rawplus_visdt )

title: GSM YAML Workflow: HTML Report
text: Use Ingest() standardise column names based workflow specs, run mapping workflows produce Mapped_* data layer.
code: mapping_wf <- gsm.core::MakeWorkflowList(   strPath = system.file("workflow/1_mappings", package = "gsm.mapping"),   strNames = c("SUBJ", "AE", "VISIT", "SITE", "STUDY", "COUNTRY") ) mapping_spec <- gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(mapping_wf) lRaw <- gsm.mapping::Ingest(lSource, mapping_spec) #> Warning: Field `visit_dt`: 19 unparsable Date(s) set to NA lMapped <- gsm.core::RunWorkflows(mapping_wf, lRaw) #> Warning: Not all specified columns in the spec are present in the data, missing columns #> are: Raw_AE$aetoxgr #> Warning: Not all specified columns in the spec are present in the data, missing columns #> are: Raw_STUDY$db_lock_dt names(lMapped) #> [1] "Mapped_AE"      "Mapped_SUBJ"    "Mapped_VISIT"   "Mapped_DATAENT" #> [5] "Mapped_COUNTRY" "Mapped_SITE"    "Mapped_STUDY"

title: GSM YAML Workflow: HTML Report
text: Run kri_TimeZFunnel metric workflow produce analysis results.
code: metrics_wf <- gsm.core::MakeWorkflowList(   strPath = system.file("workflow/2_metrics", package = "gsm.timez"),   strNames = "kri_TimeZFunnel",   bExact = TRUE ) lAnalyzed <- gsm.core::RunWorkflows(metrics_wf, lMapped) names(lAnalyzed) #> [1] "Analysis_kri_TimeZFunnel"

title: GSM YAML Workflow: HTML Report
text: 3_reporting workflows stack reshape analysis results flat data frames expected report template.
code: reporting_wf <- gsm.core::MakeWorkflowList(   strPath = system.file("workflow/3_reporting", package = "gsm.timez") ) lReporting <- gsm.core::RunWorkflows(   reporting_wf,   c(lMapped, list(lAnalyzed = lAnalyzed, lWorkflows = metrics_wf)) ) names(lReporting) #> [1] "Reporting_Bounds"            "Reporting_Results_allmonths" #> [3] "Reporting_Groups"            "Reporting_Metrics"           #> [5] "Reporting_Results"

title: GSM YAML Workflow: HTML Report
text: 4_modules workflow creates charts renders HTML report using gsm.timez’s custom template (inst/report/Report_TimeZFunnel.Rmd). workflow generates Report_TimeZFunnel.html. See Sample Report example output.
code: module_wf <- gsm.core::MakeWorkflowList(   strPath = system.file("workflow/4_modules", package = "gsm.timez"),   strNames = "Report_TimeZFunnel",   bExact = TRUE ) lReport <- gsm.core::RunWorkflows(module_wf, lReporting) lReport$Module_Report_TimeZFunnel #> [1] "/home/runner/work/gsm.timez/gsm.timez/vignettes/kri_report_AAAA0000000_Site_20260512.html"

title: gsm.timez - Timeline Z-Score Funnel Analysis GSM Extension
text: gsm.timez GSM extension longitudinal site monitoring. applies funnel plot scoring across sequential months detect sites unusual cumulative event trajectories. package includes following main functions: Timeline(): Generates site-level timeline cumulative numerator events (e.g. adverse events) sequential months. Analyze_TimeZFunnel(): Applies gsm.core::Analyze_NormalApprox() across sequential months, producing funnel plot scores site time. Flag(): Extends gsm.core::Flag() sparse-month awareness time-series data. PredictBounds_TimeZFunnel(): Applies gsm.core::Analyze_NormalApprox_PredictBounds() across sequential months produce funnel bounds visualization. Visualize_Funnel(): funnel plot single selected month, showing site Metric values Denominator Normal approximation control bounds. Visualize_Heatmap(): heatmap showing site’s flag status time. Visualize_Site(): line plot highlighting single site’s cumulative metric trajectory sites, marking flagged months.

code: library(gsm.timez) library(dplyr)  # Prepare data dfSubjects <- clindata::rawplus_dm dfNumerator <- clindata::rawplus_ae dfDenominator <- clindata::rawplus_visdt %>%   dplyr::mutate(visit_dt = as.Date(visit_dt, "%Y-%m-%d"))  # Full pipeline: Timeline -> Funnel Score -> Flag -> Visualize gsm.timez::Timeline(   dfSubjects            = dfSubjects,   dfNumerator           = dfNumerator,   dfDenominator         = dfDenominator,   strGroupCol           = "invid",   strSubjectCol         = "subjid",   strNumeratorDateCol   = "aest_dt",   strDenominatorDateCol = "visit_dt" ) %>%   gsm.timez::Analyze_TimeZFunnel() %>%   gsm.timez::Flag(vThreshold = c(-1.5, -1, 2, 3)) %>%   gsm.timez::Visualize_Heatmap(nSites = 30)

title: Generate Site-Level Cumulative Event Timeline — Timeline
text: dfSubjects data frame containing unique subject IDs grouping variables. dfNumerator data frame containing event records (numerator). must contain subject ID column date column. dfDenominator data frame containing time point records (denominator, e.g., visits). must contain subject ID column date column. strGroupCol name column dfSubjects used grouping subjects (e.g., "invid", "country"). strGroupLevel Optional character string used label grouping level, stored GroupLevel output column. NULL, defaults value strGroupCol. strSubjectCol name unique subject ID column dfSubjects. strNumeratorCol name subject ID column dfNumerator. title: Generate Site-Level Cumulative Event Timeline — Timeline
